mcqs.q: In a circuit-switched network, what can the switch do with the dedicated circuit?
options: Only make it active or inactive
mcqs.explainBn: স্লাইড অনুযায়ী সার্কিট সবসময় থাকে; সুইচ শুধু সেটাকে active/inactive করে।

mcqs.q: In a packet-switched network, the router stores packets in a:
mcqs.explainBn: রাউটারের queue প্যাকেট জমা রেখে ফরোয়ার্ড করে।

mcqs.q: Which application most needs guaranteed bandwidth and constant delay?
mcqs.explainBn: রিয়েল-টাইম ভয়েসে বিলম্ব পরিবর্তন হলে কথা ভেঙে যায়, তাই সংরক্ষিত পথ দরকার।

mcqs.q: Why can circuit switching waste capacity?
options: The reserved circuit stays allocated even when no data is being sent
Routers must recompute routes for every packet
mcqs.explainBn: চুপ থাকলেও সার্কিট দখলে থাকে, অন্য কেউ ব্যবহার করতে পারে না।

mcqs.q: Data in a packet-switched network is sent as:
mcqs.explainBn: স্লাইড: communication is done in blocks of data called packets।

mcqs.q: A university wants many students to share one Internet link for browsing and downloads. The best choice is:
options: Circuit switching, because each student needs a reserved circuit
Packet switching, because bursty traffic can share the link on demand
Circuit switching, because it removes all delay
mcqs.explainBn: ব্রাউজিং বার্স্টি — শেয়ার করলে লিংক দক্ষভাবে ব্যবহার হয়।

mcqs.q: Which statement about delay is correct?
options: Circuit switching has variable queuing delay at every switch
Packet switching can have variable delay because packets wait in router queues
Both techniques always have identical delay
mcqs.explainBn: Queue-তে অপেক্ষার সময় ট্রাফিকের উপর নির্ভর করে, তাই ডেলে পরিবর্তনশীল।

mcqs.q: According to the slides, an internet is best described as:
options: A single cable joining two computers
A switched network in which a switch connects at least two links
A router holding a packet in its queue and then sending it on
mcqs.explainBn: রাউটার প্যাকেট জমা রেখে পরে পাঠায়।

mcqs.q: A video call app on a shared Wi-Fi link sometimes freezes during heavy downloads. Which property of packet switching best explains this?
options: Packets of many users share queues, so queuing delay varies
The bandwidth is reserved for the download
mcqs.explainBn: ডাউনলোডের প্যাকেট queue ভরে ফেলে, ফলে ভিডিও প্যাকেটের অপেক্ষা বাড়ে।

written.question: A telecom company wants to design a network for real-time voice calls with guaranteed bandwidth. Identify the switching technique (Circuit or Packet) that should be used and apply its working principle to justify your choice.

concepts.name: circuit set up before transfer / switch makes it active
concepts.bn: কল শুরুর আগে সংযোগ তৈরি হয়

concepts.name: constant delay / no queuing
concepts.bn: ডেলে স্থির — real-time এর জন্য দরকার

penalties.message: Mixes up circuit switching with store-and-forward packet switching.

rubric.modelAnswer: Circuit switching should be used. In circuit switching a dedicated circuit is set up between the two end systems before the call, and the switches keep it active for the whole call. The bandwidth of that circuit is reserved, so it is guaranteed, and there is no queuing at the switches, so the delay is small and constant — exactly what real-time voice needs.

written.question: Differentiate between circuit-switched and packet-switched networks. (Any three points)

concepts.name: connection: dedicated circuit vs no dedicated path
resource sharing on demand vs reserved

rubric.modelAnswer: Circuit switching uses a dedicated circuit between the two end systems which the switch only makes active or inactive; packet switching has no dedicated path and sends data in blocks called packets. In circuit switching the bandwidth is reserved for the session, while in packet switching links are shared on demand. Routers in packet switching have queues that store and forward packets, so the delay is variable, whereas a circuit has constant delay. Circuit switching suits real-time voice; packet switching suits bursty data such as web and e-mail.
